captures.description: THE COLLECTION, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Electronic Literature Collection is open-access and free to read online:' then 'a periodical publication produced by the Electronic Literature Organization (ELO) featuring current and historical digital-born literary works', works 'created on and designed for computers or mobile devices'. Published volumes (October 2006; February 2011, '81 works'; February 2016; June 2022, '132 works across 31 languages from 42 nationalities'); key features (formats from hypertext fiction to narrative animations; access, open and with 'USB drives or CD-ROMs'); a follow-up offer on submitting to the ELO. Six cards: the ELO's collection page, PDXScholar (Volume 4), the Creative Commons Wiki, The NEXT (Volume 2), a YouTube talk, a Google shopping listing.
